formal_statement: ∀ R : Set (List Bool × List Bool), PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R → ({y : List Bool | ∃ (t : ℕ) (x w : List Bool), y = List.replicate t true ++ false :: x ∧ w.length ≤ t ∧ (x, w) ∈ R} : Language Bool) ∈ PEqualNP.Library.NP
plain_statement: For a polynomial-time relation R, the strings 1^t 0 x such that some witness of length at most t is R-related to x form an NP language. Folklore padding (as in the proof that NEXP = NP after padding). Needed by L-meta-016.
title: A relation on unary-padded inputs is an NP language
